title: C: (void) casts hide persistence failures in link_ctx.c
description: link_ctx.c has 9 instances of (void)save_tuple(ctx) and (void)seq_unlock(ctx) that silently discard NVS/lock errors. Comments say 'ignore errors to not block boot' but no LOG_ERR or metric is emitted, so downstream replay/state bugs have no root-cause trail. Fix: add LOG_WRN on failure paths even if the return is still ignored, so an AI watching logs can correlate persistence failures with later state corruption.
